title: FeatureSpec
description: Structured spec of a paper's design feature, emitted by the distiller node. Downstream integration agents implement against this document, so it must be complete enough to implement without the paper.
$comment: The distiller is handed this schema inline, and twelve of sixteen runs copied $schema/$id/title/description/type straight out of it into the instance. Refusing unknown keys here is what stops the schema from being echoed back as data.

inputs_used.description: Which ablation arm produced this spec

summary.description: One paragraph: what the feature does and the mechanism behind its gain

state.description: Every table, register, and counter the feature adds

size_bits.description: Total storage in bits at default parameters

size_formula.description: This entry's storage in bits as an arithmetic expression over `parameters[].name`, e.g. 'num_banks * (wt0_entries + wt1_entries) * wt_ctr_bits'. Allowed: numbers, parameter names, + - * / // % ** << >>, parentheses, and min, max, log2, ceil, floor, abs, int. Never ^ for a power. Evaluated at the defaults it must equal `size_bits`. Omit it only for an entry no parameter resizes; stage 4 re-derives every candidate's storage from these formulas, so a structure a knob resizes without a formula is one whose cost the search cannot see.

indexing.description: Index/hash function, inputs and fold widths

algorithms.description: Pseudocode for each operation, in execution order

trigger.description: When the host must call this: lookup time, commit time, squash

host_interfaces.description: What the feature needs from the host and what it returns

fallback.description: What to do when the host cannot provide it exactly

budget_donors.description: Which host structures can shrink to pay for the feature at iso-storage

range.description: Legal values, e.g. '[256, 65536] pow2' or 'choices: a|b|c'

unit_tests.description: Behavioral checks derived from the paper; the verify gate runs these

given.description: Input stimulus or synthetic branch stream

open_questions.description: Ambiguities in the paper the distiller could not resolve; integration agent must not guess silently
